inputs.policy: formed-wave propagation under hot products; exact conservative layer fractions; no injection or driver

summary.interpretation: bounded response only: combine spatial pressure/reaction association, relief, causality and mesh evidence

postprocessed.method: Last-cell pressure>2p1 front; 2 mm window includes that cell; linear least-squares x(t) fits from stated start to 40 us. Window is a diagnostic, not a detonation criterion.
